title: Volatility-managed sizing of the equity calendar sleeves (T1, T2, FC, MM)

candidates.vm: 0.25 x min(2, median-normalised (0.15 / 20-day realised vol of the index, lagged)) per index; normalisation constant = 2010-22 median of 0.15/rv20 so the average size is unchanged

selection: variant with the higher 2010-06..2022-12 Sharpe of the equal-weighted sum of the four sleeves
judgement: chosen variant replaces the four sleeves in the book; ONE evaluation 2023-26 vs 0.908; adopt only if vm chosen and higher
